raw.description:
Job Title: In-Home Physician Part Time - Portsmouth

Job Location: Work at Home, Ohio, United States

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Part time

Job Seniority Level:

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Part Time Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:

As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD

“The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD

Part-time employees qualify for:

  • Select benefits (see benefits guide for details)

  • Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)

  • Supplies and other perks

Required & Preferred Qualifications (MDs and DOs)

  • Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

  • Multi-state licenses (preferred)

Anticipated Weekly Hours

29.5

Time Type

Part time

Pay Range

The typical pay range for this role is:

$105.00 - $105.00

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors.

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

Great benefits for great people

We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.

This part‑time position is eligible for a range of benefits and programs that support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues. Depending on hours worked and eligibility, the benefits for this position include dental, vision, wellness resources, employee discounts, access to certain voluntary benefits, and other programs.

Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments.

We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on: 12/31/2026

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state and local laws.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Part Time Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. raw.description:
Job Title: In-Home Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant Part Time - Toledo

Job Location: Work at Home, Ohio, United States

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Part time

Job Seniority Level:

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Part Time Clinician (Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant) to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“I love seeing health plan members at home. You get a better picture of their health when you see where they live.” - Erica R., PA

“At Signify Health, we have the time to help people and to truly listen to their questions and concerns. We can help guide them so they can take better care of themselves. We really can make a change in communities.” - Ali B., NP

“I like how Signify Health manages my experience. I’m just doing the clinician part of my job without all the administrative responsibilities. I have the time to provide education so people have a better understanding of their health. I can answer their questions without rushing out the door.” - Andrew K., PA

Part-time employees qualify for:

  • Select benefits (see benefits guide for details)

  • Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)

  • Supplies and other perks

Required & Preferred Qualifications (NPs and PAs)

  • Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

  • Board certification (required)

  • Multi-state licenses (preferred)

Anticipated Weekly Hours

29.5

Time Type

Part time

Pay Range

The typical pay range for this role is:

$41.85 - $90.13

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors.

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

Great benefits for great people

We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.

This part‑time position is eligible for a range of benefits and programs that support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues. Depending on hours worked and eligibility, the benefits for this position include dental, vision, wellness resources, employee discounts, access to certain voluntary benefits, and other programs.

Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments.

We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on: 12/31/2026

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state and local laws.

Job Title: In-Home Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant Part Time - Blacksburg

Job Location: Work at Home, Virginia, United States

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Part time

Job Seniority Level:

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Part Time Clinician (Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant) to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care. You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors. Job highlights The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen. In this role, you will:
  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes
  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs
  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role
  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed
  • Conduct virtual visits as needed
  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)
A Note on Our Work Environment: As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants. Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health “I love seeing health plan members at home. About the role
FindTutors is looking for motivated EFL Tutors in Cardiff to help students improve their English language skills for academic, professional, or personal goals. Lessons can be delivered online or face-to-face anywhere in the UK.

Responsibilities

  • Teach English grammar, vocabulary, pronunciation, and conversation.

  • Adapt lessons to students’ needs, from beginners to advanced learners.

  • Support exam preparation (e.g., IELTS, Cambridge).

  • Encourage confidence and fluency in communication.

Requirements

  • Strong knowledge of English (native or advanced).

  • No tutoring experience required — just enthusiasm!

  • Friendly, patient, and motivating.

  • Flexibility to teach online or in person.

What we offer

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Competitive pay: £20–£40 per hour.

  • Teach from anywhere in the UK.

  • Access to motivated students looking to learn English.

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

We're looking for an Office Coordinator.

You'll run the day-to-day of our Leeds office, making it a well-run, safe and welcoming place for the 100+ iwocans who work from there.

The team

The office team looks after iwoca's four offices in London, Leeds, Berlin and Frankfurt, and the events that keep iwocans connected across them. The team is led by the Office & Community Manager, who is based in London.

The Leeds office is home to most of iwoca's collections, customer success and account management teams, plus smaller groups from across the business. It's busiest midweek, when most teams come in together.

The role

As Office Coordinator, you'll report to the Office & Community Manager. You'll be the person who keeps the Leeds office running, and the first person iwocans in Leeds come to when something needs sorting.

  • Ownership. You'll run the office day to day: the weekly food and drinks order, deliveries, post and supplies, and the office Soldo card, reconciled each month. You'll walk the office each week and fix small issues yourself.

  • Variety. You'll welcome visitors and candidates, sort out meeting room clashes, and book and oversee cleaners, tradespeople and suppliers, from the coffee machines and Billi taps to the plants.

  • Responsibility. You'll keep the office safe. You'll be one of the office's fire marshals and first aiders, carry out facilities maintenance checks, and keep the first aid kits stocked.

  • Community. You'll help iwocans in Leeds feel part of iwoca and enjoy being here. You'll run the weekly office tour for new joiners, help teams to celebrate key moments like work anniversaries and organise community events.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Office operations. You have at least a year's experience running the day-to-day of an office or front of house, including ordering, deliveries and visitors.

  • Suppliers and contractors. You have worked with building management, contractors and facilities suppliers, and held them to what they agreed to deliver.

  • Fixing things without being asked. You have been the person who spots what isn't working in an office and sorts it. You can talk us through examples.

  • The physical side. You're comfortable unpacking deliveries, setting up for events and moving supplies of up to 15–20kg.

Bonus:

  • First aid and fire safety. You hold first aid or fire marshal certificates. If not, we'll train you when you join.

  • Expenses. You have managed company expenses on Soldo or a similar platform.

  • Facilities qualification. You have an IWFM qualification or equivalent.

  • AI Literacy. Experience using generative AI tools to drive efficiency in administrative tasks, paired with the judgment to audit and fact-check all AI-generated content.

The salary

We expect to pay from £26,500 to £30,000 (pro rata for 20 hours a week) for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

Useful links:

  • iwoca benefits & policies

  • Interview welcome pack

Compensation Range: £26.5K - £30K

About Huawei Research and Development UK Limited

Founded in 1987, Huawei is a leading global provider of information and communications technology (ICT) infrastructure and smart devices. We have 207,000 employees and operate in over 170 countries and regions, serving more than three billion people around the world.

Our vision and mission is to bring digital to every person, home and organization for a fully connected, intelligent world. To this end, we will drive ubiquitous connectivity and promote equal access to networks; bring cloud and artificial intelligence to all four corners of the earth to provide superior computing power where you need it, when you need it; build digital platforms to help all industries and organizations become more agile, efficient, and dynamic; redefine user experience with AI, making it more personalized for people in all aspects of their life, whether they’re at home, in the office, or on the go.

This spirit of innovation has led Huawei to work in close partnership with leading academic institutions in the UK to develop and refine the latest technologies. With a shared commitment to innovation and progress, both parties have worked together to achieve common goals and establish a strong partnership. The partnership between UK and Huawei help to develop the technologies of the future that will transform the way we all communicate, work and live.

For the past 30 years we have maintained an unwavering focus, rejecting shortcuts and easy opportunities that don't align with our core business. With a practical approach to everything we do, we concentrate our efforts and invest patiently to drive technological breakthroughs.

This strategic focus is a reflection of our core values:

  • Staying customer-centric,

  • Inspiring dedication,

  • Persevering,

  • Growing by reflection.

Huawei Research and Development UK Limited Overview

Huawei’s vision is a fully connected, intelligent world. To achieve this, we work to inspire passion for basic research around the world. Our combined passion drives development across the global innovation value chain. Huawei has the largest Research and Development organization in the world with 96,000+ employees in research centers around the globe. In the UK, we already have design centers in Cambridge, London, Edinburgh and Ipswich. We continue to explore and define new research directions and new services. We have expanded our collaborations with academic researchers; researched new network architectures, integration of communications and key enabling technologies; and developed the fundamental theories of these technologies. We invite you to join us on this exciting journey and drive your career forward.

Job Summary

We are looking for individuals with a strong background in competitive programming to support Huawei’s contest talent initiative.

This is a part-time role focused on helping us better understand and evaluate contest talents across global competition communities. The emphasis is on leveraging real competition experience (e.g., ICPC, IOI) to provide practical input, as well as supporting talent recommendation and attraction.

The role is suitable for experienced ICPC participants, coaches, or individuals actively involved in competitive programming communities.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Help review and interpret contest talent profiles and achievements

  • Provide input on talent strength based on competition experience and performance signals

  • Support identification, recommendation, and attraction of promising contest talents across ICPC, IOI, Codeforces, Kaggle, etc.

  • Share insights on competition trends and talent signals within the community

  • Support internal understanding of how contest talents can be evaluated

  • Help increase awareness of Huawei’s contest talent initiative within relevant communities (informal/community-level engagement)

This job description is only an outline of the tasks, responsibilities and outcomes required of the role. The jobholder will carry out any other duties as may be reasonably required by his/her line manager. The job description and personal specification may be reviewed on an ongoing basis in accordance with the changing needs of Huawei Research and Development UK Limited.

Person Specification:

Required:

  • Strong competitive programming background (ICPC participation, coaching, or equivalent experience)

  • Familiarity with competitive programming platforms (e.g., Codeforces, AtCoder, etc.)

  • Ability to assess contest talent based on real competition experience

  • Good understanding of characteristics of strong contest talents

  • Comfortable discussing technical talent in an informal and collaborative English environment

Desired:

  • ICPC coaching or mentoring experience (university or team level)

  • Experience participating in international programming competitions

  • Active engagement in competitive programming communities

Why this role:

This is an opportunity to stay closely connected to the competitive programming community while helping shape how we understand and engage contest talents.

The role may also include opportunities to engage with Huawei teams globally, including participation in selected academic and technical programs such as summer or winter camps.

As a part-time position, it offers flexible working time and location.

About LearnLux

LearnLux is the leading provider of workplace financial wellbeing, blending fiduciary digital planning with access to one-on-one guidance from Certified Financial Planner™️ professionals. Our award-winning program helps employees navigate critical financial decisions from budgeting and benefits elections to equity compensation, home buying, and retirement so they can feel confident about their money and focused at work. Advanced reporting helps our partners understand impact, driving outcomes like reduced financial stress, increased productivity, and improved retention.

We’re building LearnLux with intention. We move quickly, operate with a high bar for quality, and value people who take ownership of their work. If you’re energized by solving new problems, taking accountability, and pushing yourself to do your best work every day, you’ll find this a rewarding environment.

We’re a venture-backed company that has raised over $35M to date and is supported by experienced investors and long-term partners. We’re a growth-focused business building for scale, and we’re excited by the opportunities and challenges that come with that journey.

The Role

LearnLux is looking for a part time Certified Financial Planner® to join our fast growing team. Leveraging the LearnLux digital experience you will work directly with employees to provide them with unbiased, holistic financial guidance. Your extensive financial experience and client-first approach will help employees prepare for and accomplish their personal and financial goals.

This role is 100% remote within the US and reports to the Director of Financial Planning.

What you’ll do

  • Must be available to work various shifts from 8 AM - 11 PM ET Monday through Friday with a typical expectation, but not guarantee, of 5-15 hours per week
  • Meet and engage with clients remotely over video, chat and email to give guidance on topics like budgeting, student loans, retirement readiness, equity compensation, debt management and more
  • Advise on the LearnLux methodology to improve and respond to the changing financial environment
  • Participate in monthly team meetings to bring your subject matter expertise to improve the LearnLux digital experience
  • Become an expert on our client’s benefit plans so you can act as an extension of their team during open enrollment

You should bring

  • CFP® designation required
  • Passion for educating individuals to take control and invest in their financial future
  • Have the ability to perform several tasks concurrently, to prioritize work, and to take direction from multiple team members
  • Can demonstrate ability to take initiative and execute
  • Experience in multiple areas of personal Finance: Retirement, Equity Compensation, investments, budgeting, debt management, Student Loans, cash flow planning, digital currencies, estate planning, insurance and more

It would be great if you also

  • CPA, Enrolled Agent, or similar
  • Certification in Credit Counseling
  • Additional Certifications
  • Startup and/or Fintech experience
  • Bi-lingual (Spanish)
  • Experience creating presentations and presenting to large audiences virtually or in-person
  • Availability to work occasional evenings and Saturday
  • Ability to occasionally travel to on-site events

LearnLux is a fit for you if you

  • Thrive in fast-moving environments and enjoy building in moments of change. We operate with urgency, and roles, priorities, and approaches evolve as we grow.
  • Like wearing multiple hats and helping define the path forward. At LearnLux, roles evolve as we grow, and employees often help create clarity, structure, and direction where it didn’t previously exist.
  • Take initiative and don’t wait to be asked. You see problems as opportunities and are comfortable stepping in to move work forward.
  • Are energized by ambiguity and willing to make decisions with imperfect information. We learn quickly by doing, and pace is a competitive advantage for us.
  • Enjoy being hands-on and owning work end to end. While strategic thinking matters, execution, follow-through, and accountability are what drive impact here.
  • Are motivated by high standards and continuous improvement. As we hit new milestones, we intentionally raise the bar on quality, ownership, and outcomes.
  • Value clear, frequent communication and collaboration. As a remote team, staying aligned through proactive communication is core to how we operate.

Closing

LearnLux strives to be an inclusive workplace and values learning from and engaging across different perspectives. Women, people of color, LGBTQIA+ individuals, and members of other minority or marginalized groups are strongly encouraged to apply.

LearnLux is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against candidates on the basis of race, ethnicity, color, national origin, age, religion, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, disability, or veteran status.

We are committed to fostering an environment that embraces diversity and inclusion and are seeking candidates from a variety of backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives to join our team. If you are interested in this opportunity but not sure if you fit this role, please apply and include a note to let us know of your interest. We’re excited to speak with you about joining our team!

The pay range for this role is listed below. Individual compensation will be commensurate with the candidate's experience and local cost of labor.

Salary Range
$60—$75 USD

About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on HR Operations & Recruiting Specialist based in the San Francisco Bay Area to support our expanding robotics and AI data collection project.

In this dual-impact role, you will be the backbone of our local workforce. You will lead initial candidate screening for specialized Robot Teleoperator roles while managing the entire employee lifecycle—driving seamless onboarding, accurate shift-based payroll coordination, and daily HR administration.

If you are organized, know California employment basics, understand operational hiring, and thrive in dynamic technical environments, this role offers direct exposure to next-generation AI and robotics programs.

Key Responsibilities

1. Candidate Sourcing & Screening

  • Conduct structured phone/video screens for entry-level and technical operational roles (VR/Console Robot Teleoperators)

  • Assess candidate reliability, technical and gaming comfort, physical readiness (e.g., equipment handling/battery swaps), and availability for shift rotations.

  • Maintain an active candidate pipeline in the ATS, coordinate interview calendars, and extend conditional offers.

2. Onboarding & Compliance

  • Lead the end-to-end new hire onboarding process, ensuring high completion rates before day-one onsite training.

  • Oversee I-9 verification, E-Verify processing (including OPT, CPT, and work visa validations), background checks, and offer letter generation.

  • Coordinate training schedules, site access, and badge readiness with onsite operations leads in Mountain View/Burlingame.

3. Payroll Management & Time Tracking

  • Audit and collect shift timesheets, break logs, and overtime records for hourly operators across weekend and weekday shifts.

  • Manage bonus program tracking (performance and attendance incentives) and submit clean payroll files to the accounting/payroll team on schedule.

  • Address employee payroll inquiries, pay stub questions, and hour discrepancies promptly.

4. HR Administration & Employee Support

  • Serve as the main point of contact for day-to-day employee questions regarding attendance policies, benefits eligibility, and workplace guidelines.

  • Maintain organized, compliant digital personnel files and track probationary/90-day milestone evaluations.

  • Facilitate offboarding workflows, final pay calculations, and exit documentation in compliance with California labor standards.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 2–4 years of combined experience in HR Operations, People Operations, or Technical/Operational Recruiting.

  • California Labor Literacy: Solid understanding of California wage-and-hour rules (meal/rest breaks, overtime calculation, paid sick leave, and final pay rules).

  • Work Authorization Familiarity: Practical experience with I-9 compliance and E-Verify processes (OPT, STEM OPT, H-1B, and student work authorizations).

  • Payroll & Time Tracking: Hands-on experience administering hourly timecards and working with payroll systems

  • Communication & Organization: Clear, proactive communication skills with the ability to maintain meticulous documentation across fast-moving shift teams.

  • Location: Based in the San Francisco Bay Area with the ability to travel locally to project facilities (Peninsula / South Bay) as operational needs require.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience supporting tech pilots, lab operations, manufacturing, or high-volume hourly workforce environments.

  • Exposure to the robotics, hardware, gaming, or AI data collection sectors.

What We Offer

  • Flexible Work Model: Remote setup with autonomy over daily task management.

  • Front-Row Seat to AI Innovation: Play a central role in staffing and organizing the teams training state-of-the-art robotic manipulation models.

raw.description:
Job Title: In-Home Health - Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant (Part Time)

Job Location: Work at Home, Minnesota, United States

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Part time

Job Seniority Level:

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Part Time Clinician (Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant) to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:

As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health

“I love seeing health plan members at home. You get a better picture of their health when you see where they live.” - Erica R., PA

“At Signify Health, we have the time to help people and to truly listen to their questions and concerns. We can help guide them so they can take better care of themselves. We really can make a change in communities.” - Ali B., NP

“I like how Signify Health manages my experience. I’m just doing the clinician part of my job without all the administrative responsibilities. I have the time to provide education so people have a better understanding of their health. I can answer their questions without rushing out the door.” - Andrew K., PA

Part-time employees qualify for:

  • Select benefits (see benefits guide for details)

  • Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)

  • Supplies and other perks

Required & Preferred Qualifications (NPs and PAs)

  • Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

  • Completion of 2080 hours of post-graduate collaborative practice hours as an NP or PA in an integrated clinical care setting (required, as is the filing of the

  • appropriate attestation with the state of Minnesota)

  • Board certification (required)

  • Multi-state licenses (preferred

Anticipated Weekly Hours

40

Time Type

Part time

Pay Range

The typical pay range for this role is:

$41.85 - $90.13

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors.

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

Great benefits for great people

We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.

This part‑time position is eligible for a range of benefits and programs that support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues. Depending on hours worked and eligibility, the benefits for this position include dental, vision, wellness resources, employee discounts, access to certain voluntary benefits, and other programs.

Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments.

About Us

Simplilearn is the world’s #1 online Bootcamp provider, enabling learners around the globe with rigorous and highly specialized training offered in partnership with world-renowned universities and leading corporations. We focus on emerging technologies and skills, such as data science, cloud computing, programming, and more — that are transforming the global economy. Our training is hands-on and immersive, including live virtual classes, integrated labs and projects, 24x7 support, and a collaborative learning environment. Over two million professionals and 2000 corporate training organizations across 150 countries have harnessed our award-winning programs to achieve their career and business goals.

Simplilearn has collaborated with Fullstack Academy to leverage its widespread footprint in the US region and partnerships with Top US universities to grow internationally.

Position Overview

The Part-Time Instructor for Agentic AI plays a key role in delivering engaging and impactful learning experiences to adult learners enrolled in our online programs.

Instructors facilitate curriculum content, support student learning, and connect technical concepts to real-world industry applications. This role involves teaching live online sessions, mentoring students, providing feedback, and contributing to a collaborative instructional environment.

Classes are delivered 100% online in a synchronous format.

Key Responsibilities

Instruction & Student Engagement

  • Deliver assigned lessons aligned with curriculum learning objectives and session plans.
  • Facilitate engaging live online instruction using instructional best practices for adult learners.
  • Provide subject matter expertise in Agentic AI.
  • Connect course content to real-world industry applications and professional practices.
  • Encourage collaboration, critical thinking, and problem-solving within the classroom environment.

Student Support & Mentorship

  • Provide individualized student support during live sessions and scheduled office hours.
  • Maintain regular communication with students regarding progress, expectations, and milestones.
  • Respond to student and staff communications in a timely and professional manner.
  • Provide clear, constructive, and timely feedback on assignments and assessments.

Performance Monitoring

  • Evaluate student progress based on course deliverables and established grading rubrics.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of student performance and engagement.
  • Identify and escalate academic or performance concerns to the Lead Instructor or appropriate staff.
  • Support performance improvement plans when necessary.

Collaboration & Professional Conduct

  • Adhere to institutional policies and instructional team standards.
  • Foster an inclusive, respectful, and professional learning environment.
  • Serve as a role model and mentor for students.
  • Collaborate with instructional staff and program teams to improve the student learning experience.
  • Represent the organization professionally when interacting with students, staff, and external stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

Education and Experience

Applicants must meet one of the following criteria:

  • Bachelor’s degree in any field AND a minimum of 3 years of professional experience in Agentic AI,
    OR
  • 5 years of professional experience in Agentic AI without a bachelor’s degree.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Strong expertise in Agentic AI concepts, frameworks, and tools (e.g., autonomous agents, LLM orchestration, multi-agent systems).
  • Ability to clearly explain complex technical topics to diverse learners.
  • Passion for education and mentoring students entering the technology industry.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a remote teaching environment.
  • Demonstrated professionalism, integrity, and ethical conduct.

Work Schedule

Part-Time instructors typically work 10–15 hours per week depending on cohort schedules.

Current Agentic AI cohorts meet during evening hours:

  • Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday /Saturday and Sunday
  • Sessions typically run 7:00 PM – 10:00 PM CST /10:00 AM -2:00PM CST

Flexibility for evening availability is required.

Compensation

The anticipated pay range for this position is $60 per hour, depending on qualifications and experience.

This position is classified as Part-Time, Non-Exempt, and employees will be compensated for all hours worked in accordance with applicable federal and state wage and hour laws.

Equal Employment Opportunity

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of application and throughout employment.

raw.description:
About us

Your work can help save students’ lives. For over 25 years, Gaggle has partnered with K-12 schools on student safety, and our team has helped save more than 8,600 student lives since 2018. Our technology flags signs of concern in students’ digital activity, our trained safety professionals review them around the clock so the right people can step in before a crisis, and our coaching and therapy services help students get support afterward. Today we serve more than 6 million students in over 1,500 districts, and protecting their data is central to that trust. Join our fully remote team, named a 2026 Top Workplace for remote work.

The opportunity

We're at a rare point in Gaggle's history. Our platform is evolving, and we're modernizing the infrastructure and engineering practices behind it, with security built in from the start and everything defined as code. Our engineering is becoming AI-first: engineers own the design and architecture, AI writes the code, and every change goes through risk-based governance, with review and controls matched to the risk of the change.

We're also rebuilding much of our IT and security foundation, including the identity systems our company runs on, and you'll lead it. Most security leaders inherit a program and spend years working around old decisions. Here, you'll define what our security, compliance and IT should look like and build it, in close partnership with a hands-on CTO.

What you'll do

  • Own the security and compliance program. Define the program, set priorities and implement it. Serve as Gaggle's Information Security Officer.
  • Mature our compliance posture. Maintain SOC 2, and lead our alignment with FedRAMP as K-12 requirements evolve. Prepare for HITRUST if our health-related products require it.
  • Rebuild our IT foundation. Modernize identity and SSO, endpoint management and security, data loss prevention, and access management as we move off legacy infrastructure.
  • Build security into how we engineer. Partner with engineering to define control requirements, review designs and make compliance evidence part of how we build and ship.
  • Build a security-aware culture. Educate and equip employees so security becomes part of how we work, not a gate.
  • Enable safe AI adoption. Set the guardrails (policy, data handling and vendor review) that let the company move fast with AI, without slowing it down.
  • Lead our Systems Support Engineering team and shape how it grows as our platform and tools evolve. The three-person team is the top tier of technical support for our customer platform, handling the hardest escalations, and also runs internal IT.
  • Lead the decommissioning of legacy infrastructure (data sanitization, access and contract exit), in close partnership with the CTO.
  • Make the case for investment. Weigh costs against risk, prioritize initiatives and recommend where we invest.

What you'll bring

  • Experience building or substantially maturing a security and compliance program.
  • Hands-on implementation. You're comfortable doing the work yourself, not only directing it.
  • AI-forward in your own work. You use AI tools every day and actively look for ways to apply them to security, compliance and IT.
  • GRC expertise: policies, controls, risk management, audits, and holding engineering accountable for controls. You've obtained and maintained a certification such as SOC 2, HITRUST or FedRAMP.
  • Real cloud security literacy (AWS preferred). You can read an architecture and spot a missing control, and you understand OWASP and why it matters. You don't need to write code.
  • Experience leading IT and identity changes, such as a company-wide MDM, EDR or DLP rollout, or an SSO migration.
  • Experience leading an operational support team, such as IT support or escalation-level technical support.
  • Strong judgment about what to fix first, and the ability to explain why.
  • A business partner's mindset. You make risk-based trade-offs that help the business grow safely, and you'd rather find a path to yes than build a wall.
  • Steady, empathetic people leadership.

Our Team Commitment

Gaggle is proud to be recognized as a 2026 Top Workplace. We are committed to equal opportunity without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, marital status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

The ideal person brings ideas forward, works through them with the team, and has a sense of ownership of where the product is going.

We're looking for someone who uses AI well, brings the judgment to catch its mistakes, and will help shape how our team builds with it. Scheduling & Start Date Details:

  • This is a highly telephonic nursing role requiring continuous work within an inbound/outbound call queue along with virtual calls. Nurses must be comfortable spending the majority of their workday on the phone participating in conversations. This is a desk-based position that requires nurses to remain at their workstation throughout the workday.Calls are routed through a computer-based phone system and must be answered directly from the queue. Candidates seeking a flexible, mobile work environment or a role that allows them to be away from their desk for extended periods may not find this position to be a good fit.
  • UBC provides a desktop computer system, not a laptop. This role is designed to be performed from a dedicated home office or HIPAA-compliant workspace and is not intended for mobile or travel-based work.
  • Work Hours:The anticipated schedule is 11:00 AM-8:00 PM ET or 12:00 PM-9:00 PM ET and employees should expect to remain on their assigned shift based on business needs. Schedule changes cannot be guaranteed and opportunities to move to earlier shifts may be limited or unavailable.
  • Weekend Rotation: This role includes a rotating Saturday shift (9:00 AM – 2:00 PM ET) approximately every 5 weeks. Saturday hours are paid as overtime. Team members may also be required to work select holidays on a rotating basis to support business needs.
  • Due to the extensive onboarding and training process, no planned time off can be accommodated during the 8-week training period.
  • Travel: One week of travel during training (business-paid). In addition, occasional travel may be required throughout the year for training, client meetings, conferences, team meetings, or other business-related events. Scheduled in January.
  • Licensing: Registered Nurse license in good standing in your state of residence; candidates must hold or be eligible to obtain a Compact Nursing License (where applicable), obtain and maintain a California RN license through endorsement upon hire, and be willing to obtain additional state licenses as required. All licensing and renewal costs are the employee's responsibility.
  • Start Date: 12/7/2026

Brief Description:

Performs as a Clinical Case Manager supporting healthcare providers and patients through telephonic support for client funded contracts. This includes: telephonic support to healthcare providers, review of payor specific coverage criteria, completing clinical review of prior authorization and appeal submissions and providing written communication utilizing client approved program resources. This role will build and develop strong customer relationships and support all activities that facilitate patient access.

Specific job duties:

  • Adhere to principles as stipulated by program specific contractual agreements and company practices.
  • Demonstrate clinical competency regarding reimbursement, product, and medical records and will review and train other team members on these concepts.
  • Troubleshoot complex cases, identify trends (spanning multiple disease-states), investigate data, and resolve escalated issues related to complex reimbursement from both internal and external stakeholders including prior authorization denials and/or appeals.
  • Perform review of payer product coverage criteria and denial letters for documentation required for submission for coverage determination.
  • Provide consistent and effective communication with healthcare providers, utilizing approved resources, regarding payer coverage criteria and information that is missing for payor submission.
  • Professional resource for IB/OB inquiries with focus on data collection, assembling accurate, timely, clear updates and documenting summary of follow up phone calls, patient inquiries, and outcomes including clinical notes and medical record/chart review when applicable.
  • Gathers, analyzes, and prepares data for Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and/or client meetings.
  • Participates in program specific customer meetings and training sessions.
  • Report Adverse Drug Events that have been experienced by the patient in accordance with manufacturer requirements.
  • Attend manufacturer hosted conferences, customer meetings/training, and QBRs as requested (including requests to travel for in-person attendance).
  • Special projects and other duties as assigned.

NA

  • Minimum- associate degree and professional nursing license
  • Registered Nurse License in good standing in the state in which you work, telephonic clinical roles are required to have a Compact State License in eligible states; additionally, employee must be willing to obtain Compact State license at such time as their state elects to adopt Compact legislation
  • Telephonic clinical roles are required to have a California State License and the employee must be willing to obtain additional Single State Licenses upon request.
  • Previous experience in the PBM and/or healthcare industry
  • Competent ability to research, analyze, prepare reports, and document clearly

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, specifically Excel
  • Ability to handle a fast-paced environment and multi-tasking

The Business Development Representative (BDR) supports Zonar’s sales team by identifying, engaging, and qualifying prospective customers within the vocational sector (transportation, field service, construction, and related industries). This role is focused on building pipeline through a balanced mix of outbound prospecting and inbound lead follow-up, using a consultative approach to set high-quality meetings for Account Executives.
This role is ideal for someone who is persistent, curious, and motivated by results—comfortable initiating conversations, learning customer challenges, and turning interest into opportunity.

Key Responsibilities and Duties:

  • Conduct outbound prospecting through cold calls, emails, social media, and personalized outreach to generate new sales opportunities.
  • Follow up on inbound leads generated by marketing campaigns, webinars, and content downloads.
  • Research target companies and contacts to tailor outreach based on industry, fleet size, and operational challenges.
  • Identify and engage decision-makers and influencers within transportation, maintenance, and operations teams.
  • Conduct discovery conversations to assess prospect needs, challenges, and fit for Zonar’s telematics solutions.
  • Clearly communicate Zonar’s value proposition using a consultative, customer-focused approach.
  • Schedule qualified meetings and demos for Account Executives, contributing directly to pipeline growth.
  • Maintain accurate records of all outreach, conversations, and qualification notes in CRM (Salesforce or Microsoft Dynamics).
  • Track and manage leads through the sales funnel to ensure timely follow-up and consistent engagement.
  • Collaborate closely with Account Executives to align on target accounts, outreach strategies, and qualification criteria.
  • Partner with Marketing to provide feedback on lead quality, campaign performance, and market insights.
  • Develop and maintain a working knowledge of Zonar’s solutions, including ELD compliance, GPS tracking, asset management, and smart fleet tools.
  • Identify trends, common objections, and messaging effectiveness to help improve outbound strategies, call scripts, and email sequences.
  • Stay informed on industry trends and competitor offerings to position Zonar effectively in conversations.
  • Participate in sales training, team huddles, and coaching sessions to continuously improve sales skills and product knowledge.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Bachelor’s degree or at least 1 year of experience in outbound business development, inside sales, or a related role.
  • Proven experience with cold calling and prospecting in a B2B environment.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to engage mid-level and senior decision-makers.
  • Comfort using CRM systems (Salesforce or Microsoft Dynamics preferred) and sales research tools.
  • Ability to work independently while consistently meeting activity and conversion goals.
  • Energetic, persistent, and motivated by measurable outcomes.
  • Strong organizational skills and follow-through.
  • Ability to adapt messaging and approach based on market feedback.
  • Experience or interest in vocational industries such as transportation, logistics, construction, or field services is a plus.
Salary: 55k-60k/yr + commission

Intelligence Driven Innovation.

Rekor Systems, Inc.,(NASDAQ: REKR) is a trusted global authority in the development and implementation of intelligent infrastructure focused on addressing critical challenges across public safety, transportation management, and urban mobility markets. With our ‘Rekor One’ roadway intelligence engine as our foundation, we collect and transform raw data into actionable insights that gives governments and businesses a comprehensive picture of roadways, vehicles, pedestrians, traffic, incidents, while providing an intuitive environment that makes collaboration across teams and organizations easy. Rekor leverages computer vision, machine learning, and big data analytics to drive AI-enabled IoT solutions (‘AIoT’) on the edge of the network with unparalleled speed, accuracy, and agility. With our disruptive AI-powered technology, integrated hardware and software solutions, and state of the art machine learning models, we deliver actionable insights and transformative impact that increase roadway safety, efficiency, and sustainability for our customers and citizens, while enabling safer, smarter, greener, and more equitable cities and communities.

Our employees represent the best and smartest top talent in our industry, and we select individuals to be a part of our team who help to define our culture and success. Rekor’s Values and Leadership Principals are: People First, Customer Success, Earn Trust, Deliver Impact and Think Big and Bold!

As a Senior Product Manager, you will be the leader of efforts and responsibilities for managing B2B and B2G SaaS products and services powered by video, analytics, and machine learning.

  • Work internally and externally with sales, customer success teams and the customers and partners themselves to understand market needs and use cases for our products
  • Develop new product ideas based on brainstorming, market research, customer interviews, discovery processes, competitive analysis, and technological viability.

To provide standard ESL courses to our Chinese young learners using our online teaching system. An excellent working package will be provided to the right candidate depending on overall qualification, fluency in English, teaching ability and educational background.

  • Base rate offered with or without class

  • 10% - 20% Class Completion Bonus

  • Trial Class Enrolment bonus(High bonus)

  • Perfect Attendance Bonus

  • Salary paid thru Paypal

  • Additional incentives monthly

  • Double pays and extra payment for holidays (Office-based)

  • Meal Bonus

  • Competitive and encouraging promotion system monthly and yearly

  • Professional Improving and Training system(including TESOL certificate)

Teacher’s primary responsibilities:

  • Preparing for 1-to-1 online classes

  • Doing corrections and conducting effective instruction during the classes

  • Doing assessments and tests for the students

  • Abiding by school regulations and management, achieving the teaching goal as scheduled with high quality

  • Patient and can manage having classes with any age group

  • Energetic, patient, responsible and cheerful

  • Evening and Weekend schedules are preferred

How to Apply

Interested parties please send the below information to (your email address):

  • A cover letter

  • A full resume

  • An audio sample of you speaking in English

  • Your Skype ID

  • Your preferred working schedule

For more information. You may visit our site:www.Acadsoc.PH.

About the Company:

Acadsoc is an online education company providing a diversity of tutoring services to its customers. headquartered in Shenzhen (China), it has branch offices in Hong Kong, Manila, London and New York with more than 1500+ employees worldwide.

“Acadsoc 1-to-1 Online English Tutoring Service” is currently attracting more than 600,000 unique visitors per month with more than 400,000 registered users since August 2014, and it has made Acadsoc one of the largest 1-to-1 online ESL provider in China.

“Acadsoc Studying Abroad Service” has been sending hundreds of students to study in the TOP schools in US and UK. It has associated with more than 80 schools in UK and 60 schools in US.

“Acadsoc International School·Online” is currently providing American elementary education courses to Chinese K12 students to introduce more advanced education resource into China.

In Acadsoc, we believe that global knowledge can change peoples' lives, so by sharing it, we could provide equal learning opportunity for all and change the world we are living in. Our mission is to create the world’s most efficient and diverse learning and teaching platform for each and everyone.

In April 2016, again Acadsoc was injected a ¥31 million capital in series A by “Ginkgo” a well-known VC in China, who’s the investor of “Moutai” and “UnionPay”. Acadsoc is currently in its process of being listed in the stock market of China with an estimated market value of ¥500 million in CNY.

At Workplace Options (WPO), we deliver human-centric solutions that empower people to thrive - personally and professionally. With a global team of more than 4,800 professionals, we provide real-time emotional support, therapy, coaching, mindfulness, and family services to millions worldwide. Since 1982, we’ve partnered with employers, health plans, and insurers to design flexible, forward-thinking programs that evolve alongside today’s changing workforce.

Today, we support 160 million people across 150,000 organizations, including over half of Fortune 500 companies. Now part of the TELUS Health family, we are expanding our global impact by combining decades of wellbeing expertise. Together, we’re building healthier, more resilient organizations—one person at a time.

Current Opportunity: Proposal Team Manager (1-Year Contract)

Location: Canada

Onsite/Hybrid/Remote: Remote or hybrid depending on your proximity to our Toronto or Montreal office

Salary: $85-90k CAD a year plus we offer a competitive range of benefits


What you will do:

We are looking for a skilled Proposal Team Manager to manage the development of business proposals. The ideal candidate will have a keen eye for detail, excellent project management skills, and the ability to produce compelling proposals that meet client requirements and drive business growth. The Proposal Team Manager will also manage the proposal development process, ensuring timely and high-quality submissions.

Responsibilities:
  • Lead Proposal Development: Oversee the end-to-end proposal process, from initial request to final submission, ensuring compliance with client requirements and internal standards.
  • Team Management: Supervise and mentor a team of proposal writers, coordinators, and subject matter experts, fostering a collaborative and high-performance environment.
  • Strategic Planning: Develop proposal strategies that effectively address client needs and highlight our company’s value proposition.
  • Quality Assurance: Review and edit proposal content for clarity, consistency, and compliance, ensuring a compelling and persuasive narrative.
  • Stakeholder Coordination: Collaborate with sales, marketing, finance, legal, and technical teams to gather necessary information and insights for proposals.
  • Process Improvement: Implement best practices and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of the proposal development process.
  • Deadline Management: Ensure all proposals are completed and submitted on time, adhering to internal and external deadlines.

Qualifications/Skills:
  • Minimum of 10 years in proposal management and/or 5 years in a leadership role.
  • Experience in EAP is preferred.
  • Strong project management and organizational abilities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud, Microsoft Office Suite and proposal management software.
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple proposals simultaneously.
  • Attention to detail and commitment to quality.

What we offer:

At Workplace Options, we don’t just deliver wellbeing services to our clients, we champion wellbeing for our own employees as well. Examples of our benefits and commitment to employee wellbeing include:

Paid Time Off, Life Insurance, Employer Pension Contribution, Travel Reimbursement, Extended healthcare, dental and vision benefits, Life insurance, AD&D and Long-term disability insurance, Monthly clinical supervision, Supervision stipend, Training/tuition reimbursement, Access to professional monthly clinical development webinars & professional development workshops, Gym Reimbursement, Wellness rewards, Access to EAP benefits and all WPO services, Mentorship Program, 24/7 support for risk calls, Employee exchange programme, Comprehensive training provided for this position.At Workplace Options, we are committed to and are accountable for building a workplace where individuals feel empowered to bring their whole selves to work, free from judgment or fear of discrimination. We understand that having a diverse organization is only the beginning and it will require nurturing and care to thrive. We will continue to take action to ensure we achieve equitable and measurable outcomes.

We strive to cultivate a space where diverse voices are not only heard but actively sought out and valued for the unique insights they bring. By embracing and promoting authenticity, we aim to build a vibrant and inclusive community that fosters collaboration, innovation, belonging and personal growth.

raw.excerpt: Overview The Lifeway Internship Program is a unique opportunity designed to provide college students and recent graduates with a valuable learning experience that fosters growth both professionally, personally, and spiritually.
raw.description:
Overview

The Lifeway Internship Program is a unique opportunity designed to provide college students and recent graduates with a valuable learning experience that fosters growth both professionally, personally, and spiritually. Our internships go far beyond "busy work"—you’ll engage in meaningful projects, gain hands-on experience, and be empowered to make an impact. Interns at Lifeway receive professional development, have opportunities for exposure to senior leaders, and benefit from mentoring relationships with experts in their chosen field.

Job Overview

This intern will help the Organizational Development team put AI to work in everyday OD and HR processes. Based on the OD & Talent Experience team and partnering closely with IT Operations, you will find HR processes that AI can improve, build a suite of HR applications in Claude, and contribute to the adoption and change management work that gets them implemented. The work reaches beyond HR to the experience of team members, leaders and candidates, and at Lifeway AI is meant to amplify the work of our people, not replace it.

Internship Program Details & Requirements

  • Compensation: Lifeway’s summer internship program offers a competitive hourly pay rate, and all necessary equipment is provided.
  • Work Schedule: Interns work an average of 32 hours per week, with core workdays from Tuesday to Thursday. The expectation is that the internship is the primary focus during working hours.
  • Program Duration: June 7 - August 11, 2027 (11 weeks). Interns must commit to participating in the entire program.
  • Eligibility: Candidates must be enrolled in an undergraduate or graduate program and have completed at least two years of study by the internship start date. Recent graduates (December 2026 or May 2027) are also eligible.
  • Development Opportunities: Weekly professional development sessions are provided, including specialized training, mentorship, and leadership development.
  • Remote Structure: This is a remote position in the U.S., with required in-person attendance for orientation (June 7 - 11, 2027) and end-of-summer presentations (August 9-11, 2027) in Nashville. Travel costs for these events are covered by Lifeway.
  • Application Deadline: Applications are due by December 31, with interviews beginning as soon as possible. Selections are finalized by April 1.

Explore our culture further at team.lifeway.com/culture-code

Remote position based in the contiguous 48 United States with occasional travel to Nashville for in-person team meetings

Responsibilities

  • Live out Lifeway’s mission and values, showing deep commitment to Kingdom work
  • Map current HR workflows with and identify how AI can save time, reduce errors or improve the employee experience.
  • Partner with IT Operations to assess feasibility, data requirements and approved tools for each opportunity.
  • Prioritize opportunities by impact and effort and agree on a summer build list with the leader, mentor and IT Operations.
  • Work within IT-approved tools and Lifeway's data classification policy
  • Involving IT Operations before any tool touches employee data.
  • Design and build a suite of HR applications in Claude, such as custom skills, projects and interactive tools.
  • Test each tool with its intended users, gather feedback and revise.
  • Document each tool so HR teams can use and maintain it after the summer.
  • Develop a rollout plan for each tool, including who uses it, what changes in their work and how success is measured.
  • Create training materials such as quick-start guides, short videos and live demos for HR teams.
  • Track usage and time saved, report results to the leader and IT Operations
  • Contribute to defining AI skills and proficiency levels for job studies and career paths.
  • Overnight travel for Orientation, and Final Presentation weeks

Qualifications

Education

Bachelor's degree in HR, I/O Psychology, OD, HR Analytics or a related field, strongly preferred

Enrolled or completed post-graduate degree in HR, I/O Psychology, OD, HR Analytics or a related field, preferred

Skills, Knowledge, & Experiences, required

  • Workplace experience through an internship, assistantship, or part-time or full-time role
  • Hands-on use of generative AI tools for work or academic projects beyond basic prompting, such as a custom assistant, reusable workflow or tool others used
  • Coursework or experience in core HR or I/O concepts such as job analysis, training design, organizational behavior or change management
  • Clear written communication, including explaining technical ideas to non-technical audiences
  • Ability to learn new technology independently and troubleshoot without step-by-step direction
  • Sound judgment with confidential employee information
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365

Actively involved in an evangelical Christian church

Skills, Knowledge, & Experiences, preferred

  • Enrolled in a graduate program
  • Experience with Claude, including projects, artifacts or skills
  • Interest in or exposure to coding (Python, JavaScript or HTML) or low-code tools such as Power Automate or Power BI
  • Experience with an HRIS or applicant tracking system, such as Oracle HCM or iCIMS
  • Experience designing or facilitating training
  • Familiarity with a change management framework such as ADKAR or Kotter
  • Coursework or experience in people analytics or survey design

description: Overview Certara accelerates medicines using proprietary biosimulation software, technology and services to transform traditional drug discovery and development.

raw.title: Enterprise Account Manager
raw.excerpt: Overview Certara accelerates medicines using proprietary biosimulation software, technology and services to transform traditional drug discovery and development.
raw.description:
Overview

Certara accelerates medicines using proprietary biosimulation software, technology and services to transform traditional drug discovery and development. Its clients include more than 2,000 biopharmaceutical companies, academic institutions, and regulatory agencies across 62 countries.

As an Enterprise Account Manager you will be working with world class expert drug development consultants in client engagements and be supported during the Business Development process by required expert teams. As a precursor to consultant engagement with the client, our candidates will be responsible for identifying and pursuing strategic business with clients after qualifying them with a needs assessment including, understanding their business model and corporate objectives, understanding their development program focus, objectives and priorities, understanding their critical decisions and challenges and financial position. It is after this qualification process that the appropriate Certara consulting resources are identified for engagement and are introduced to the client as the Certara resource team.


Responsibilities

  • Identify and pursue strategic business with new clients
  • Identify and pursue business growth opportunities within assigned clients
  • Conduct proper discovery to understand and qualify client needs, including understanding of business model and corporate objectives, development program focus, and priorities
  • Negotiate contract terms by understanding critical decision timelines, challenges, and financial position
  • Lead and facilitate client meetings with consulting resources, ensure internal stakeholders are properly briefed on client meeting plan and management
  • Act as main liaison for client and Certara
  • Facilitate execution of CDA/ MSA
  • Collaborate with project team to ensure timely delivery and quality of all project deliverables
  • Communicate issues, issue status, and issue resolution on a regular basis
  • Provide leadership and timely feedback to keep all stakeholders, including senior management, informed of project progress
  • Ensure Salesforce is properly updated

Qualifications

  • Minimum a Bachelor’s Degree (science related curriculum a plus) with a demonstrated career path in Business Development to support the sought drug development experience and understanding required for this position.
  • A seasoned and well-rounded biopharmaceutical executive is required with minimum combined business development experience of 3+ years
  • Thorough understanding of the drug development processes, with the ability to converse with C-suite leadership in Biopharma companies, is essential. Thorough understanding of Clinical Pharmacology and Model Informed Drug Development (PK/PD, QSP, PBPK and MBMA) is a plus.
  • Possesses broad knowledge of the pharmaceutical space and current macro trends within the industry. Able to lead strategic business planning process based on a thorough understanding of industry trends and opportunities and effectively solve strategic challenges.
  • Proven ability to lead initiatives: work collaboratively with teams to achieve objectives. Achieves organizational focus on key priorities. Provides clear direction, delegates, actively communicates. Superior project management skills.
  • Proven success in working collaboratively with cross functional commercialization teams with a strong business orientation and ability to view issues from multiple functional perspectives.
  • Experienced and adept in a variety of negotiating settings. Able to engage effectively; establishes a clear negotiation strategy and manages a tight process.
  • Proven experience in identifying, evaluating and pursuing business development opportunities within new and existing key markets.
  • Demonstrated ability to gain credibility through successful leadership in a matrix environment, across a range of functions, position levels and geography
  • Strong communication and influencing skills

Certara bases all employment-related decision on merit, taking into consideration qualifications, skills, achievement, and performance. We treat all applicants and employees without regard to personal characteristics such as race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, nationality, marital status, pregnancy, physical or mental condition, genetic information, military service, or other characteristic protected by law.
