raw.title: MDM Technical Architect
raw.excerpt: Marlabs, a global AI and Digital Solutions Consulting firm, delivers intelligent solutions across AI, data, analytics, and product engineering.
raw.description:
Marlabs, a global AI and Digital Solutions Consulting firm, delivers intelligent solutions across AI, data, analytics, and product engineering. Since 2000, we have partnered with some of the largest healthcare, life sciences, financial services, and government organizations worldwide. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we have an exciting opportunity for a highly skilled MDM Technical Architect to join our innovative and dynamic team.

MDM Technical Architect | About You

As an MDM Technical Architect, you will define the end-to-end architecture for enterprise Master Data Management, identity resolution, data quality, governance, and analytics solutions. You will establish the technical vision and design for integrating multiple source systems into a governed Microsoft Fabric and OneLake ecosystem, creating trusted golden records that support enterprise reporting and analytics. You bring deep expertise in MDM architecture, entity modeling, match and survivorship strategies, data stewardship, cloud data platforms, and enterprise security, along with the ability to guide stakeholders through complex platform and architecture decisions.

MDM Technical Architect | Day-to-Day

  • Define the overall MDM solution vision and architecture, covering source ingestion, entity and relationship modeling, identity resolution, source crosswalks, survivorship, golden records, stewardship, security, governance, and downstream consumption.
  • Evaluate commercial MDM platforms and custom cloud-native approaches, recommending the right solution based on scalability, licensing, stewardship, operating-model, and long-term support requirements.
  • Design integration patterns across enterprise source systems, Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, Fabric Data Factory, dbt, APIs, Power BI, and related analytics platforms.
  • Define deterministic and probabilistic matching strategies, confidence thresholds, duplicate detection, household resolution, survivorship rules, and exception-review processes.
  • Establish architectural guardrails for data quality, metadata, lineage, auditability, PII protection, role-based access, environment separation, and deployment governance.
  • Lead architecture workshops and design reviews, translating business requirements and source-data realities into solution blueprints, logical data models, source-to-target mappings, and implementation roadmaps.
  • Guide technical teams through implementation, resolve complex architectural issues, and ensure delivery remains aligned with approved enterprise, security, and governance standards.
  • Define production-readiness, transition, and support requirements, including monitoring, operational runbooks, knowledge transfer, and sustainable platform ownership.

MDM Technical Architect | Skills & Experience

  • 10+ years of experience in Data Architecture, Solution Architecture, MDM, Data Engineering, or Enterprise Data Management, including leadership of complex MDM or data-modernization programs.
  • Deep expertise in MDM architecture, entity resolution, golden-record design, match/merge, survivorship, crosswalks, hierarchy and relationship management, and data stewardship.
  • Strong architecture experience with Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, Fabric Data Factory, Azure, dbt, Power BI, lakehouse or medallion architectures, and enterprise integration patterns.
  • Experience evaluating or implementing commercial MDM platforms such as Profisee, Informatica MDM, Reltio, Ataccama, or Stibo Systems, or designing custom cloud-native identity-resolution solutions.
  • Strong understanding of data governance, metadata, lineage, data quality, security, PII protection, least-privilege access, auditability, and regulated-data practices.
  • Excellent client-facing architecture, facilitation, and communication skills, with the ability to explain platform options, trade-offs, risks, and recommendations to executive, business, and technical stakeholders.

raw.title: Legal Counsel, Enterprise Asset Management and Commercial Solutions
raw.excerpt: Build an Aviation Career You’re Proud Of At StandardAero, we use our ingenuity and know-how to find solutions for the simple to the most complex challenges in aviation.
raw.description:
Build an Aviation Career You’re Proud Of

At StandardAero, we use our ingenuity and know-how to find solutions for the simple to the most complex challenges in aviation. Together, we get the job done and done well. Our stability, resources, and respectful culture supports you in building a solid career with a great team you can count on day in and day out for the long term.

As Legal Counsel for Enterprise Asset Management and Commercial Solutions, you will provide, counsel, advice, and support to StandardAero’s Commercial Engine Services business unit and report to the VP & Assistant General Counsel.

Location: Scottsdale, AZ, San Antonio, TX, Dallas, TX preferred. Willing to consider remote candidates as well.

What you’ll do:

  • Provide strategic legal support to the Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) and Commercial Solutions business teams throughout the transaction lifecycle, ensuring commercial transactions align with business objectives while appropriately identifying and mitigating legal and commercial risks.
  • Draft, review, analyze, and negotiate a broad range of commercial agreements, including engine purchase, sale, exchange, and lease agreements; maintenance, repair, and overhaul (MRO) service agreements; OEM agreements; dealer and intellectual property license agreements; proposals and requests for proposals (RFPs); agency and sales intermediary agreements; non-disclosure agreements; and other commercial contracts as required.
  • Partner with cross-functional stakeholders and other members of the Legal Department to provide clear, practical, and business-oriented legal advice on contractual, transactional, regulatory, and commercial matters.
  • Manage in-house litigation and pre-litigation matters, including legal research, memorandum drafting, motion practice, e-discovery and discovery responses, lien filings, secured transactions, abandoned asset matters, and the preparation of demand and response letters. Coordinate and manage outside counsel where appropriate.
  • Lead and support continuous improvement initiatives by developing and enhancing legal processes, contract templates, policies, procedures, and contract management practices to improve efficiency, consistency, and risk management.
  • Identify, assess, and manage legal and commercial risks across a broad range of business activities, providing practical, solutions-oriented recommendations that enable informed business decisions.
  • Develop and deliver legal and compliance training for business teams and management on contracting, commercial law, regulatory requirements, competition law, and other legal topics to promote awareness and consistent application of legal principles.
  • Serve as the business unit legal point of contact for anti-corruption and trade compliance matters, partnering with corporate compliance teams to support due diligence, transactional reviews, and compliance initiatives while helping ensure adherence to applicable laws and company policies.

Position Requirements:

  • Juris Doctor (J.D.) from an accredited law school and active membership in good standing with a U.S. state bar.
  • Minimum of five (5) years of relevant commercial transactional experience in a leading law firm and/or an in-house legal department.
  • Experience supporting complex commercial transactions, including asset purchases, sales, exchanges, leasing transactions, and strategic commercial agreements.
  • Experience managing disputes, litigation, insurance matters, and related legal proceedings.
  • Experience working with OEMs, suppliers, customers, and other aviation industry stakeholders preferred.
  • Strong understanding of contract lifecycle management, negotiation strategies, and commercial risk allocation.
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 20% as business needs require.

Preferred Characteristics:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, engineering, accounting, or a related field preferred
  • Aviation industry or aviation law experience preferred.
  • Knowledge of anti-corruption laws (including the U.S. Foreign Corrupt Practices Act, U.K. Bribery Act, and Canada’s Corruption of Foreign Public Officials Act) and trade compliance matters, including ITAR, EAR, global sanctions, SDN lists, and applicable Executive Orders.
  • Demonstrated ability to serve as an effective change agent by driving process improvements, challenging conventional approaches, and implementing innovative solutions.
  • Exceptional organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and perform effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong business judgment and the ability to provide clear, practical, and solution-oriented legal advice.
  • Excellent written, verbal, negotiation, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively at all levels of the organization.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, global business environment and provide practical, solutions-oriented legal advice.
  • Experience working with OEMs, suppliers, customers, and other aviation industry stakeholders preferred.

Benefits that make life better:

  • Comprehensive Healthcare
  • 401(k) with 100% company match; up to 5% vested
  • Paid Time Off starting on day one
  • Bonus opportunities
  • Health- & Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Short- & Long-Term Disability
  • Life & AD&D Insurance
  • Learning & Training opportunities

Benefits & Perks vary by Country.

With a 20-year history of innovation, Riverbed is agile and proven—and we continue to disrupt the market with differentiated solutions that help customers deliver secure, seamless digital experiences and accelerate enterprise performance. raw.description:
The Clinical Research Associate at Medpace is offering the unique opportunity to have an exciting career in the research of drug and medical device development while making a difference in the lives of those around them. For those with medical and/or health/life science interest and background who want to explore the research field, travel Turkey, and be part of a team bringing pharmaceutical and medical devices to market - this could be the right opportunity for you! This position is fully home-based and remote.

Our successful Clinical Research Associates possess varied backgrounds in medical and other science-related healthcare fields. Individuals who have succeeded in the CRA role include:

  • Nurses
  • Dieticians
  • Pharmacy Technicians
  • Pharmaceutical/Device Sales Representatives
  • Biotech Engineers
  • PhD/Pharm.D candidates
  • Health and Wellness Coordinators
  • Site Coordinators, Clinical Research Coordinators
  • Research Assistants.

PACE® – MEDPACE CRA TRAINING PROGRAM

Through our PACE® Training Program, you will join other Professionals Achieving CRA Excellence:

  • PACE® provides the platform to effectively and confidently carry out your duties, enhance your current abilities and ultimately help you become a high-functioning independent Medpace CRA.
  • PACE® will prepare you by developing your CRA skills through interactive discussions and hands on job-related exercises and practicums.

UNEXPECTED REWARDS

This role takes you on a journey through travel and excitement which will allow you to make a difference on a large scale through the enhancement of pharmaceuticals and medical devices. The CRA position provides many other distinctive advantages including:

  • Dynamic working environment, with varying responsibilities day-to day
  • Expansive experience in multiple therapeutic areas
  • Work within a team of therapeutic and regulatory experts
  • Defined CRA promotion and growth ladder with potential for mentoring and management advancements
  • Competitive pay and bonus program

Responsibilities

  • Conduct qualification, initiation, monitoring, and closeout visits for research sites in compliance with the approved protocol;
  • Communication with the medical site staff including coordinators, clinical research physicians and their site staff;
  • Verifying adequate investigator qualifications, training and resources, including facilities, laboratories, equipment, and staff;
  • Medical record and research source documentation verification against case report form data, including informing the site staff of any entry errors, ensuring good documentation practices are being adhered to and communicating protocol deviations appropriately per SOPs, GCP and applicable regulatory requirements;
  • Verification that the investigator is enrolling only eligible subjects;
  • Regulatory document review;
  • Medical device and/or investigational product/drug accountability and inventory;
  • Verification and review of adverse events, serious adverse events, concomitant medications and corresponding illnesses to confirm accurate data reporting in accordance with the protocol;
  • Assessing the clinical research site’s patient recruitment and retention success and offering suggestions for improvement;
  • Completion of monitoring reports and follow-up letters, which includes providing summaries of the significant findings, deviations, deficiencies, and recommended actions to secure compliance.

Qualifications

  • Minimum of a bachelor’s degree; Health or life science related field preferred;
  • Willing to travel approximately 60-80% nationally;
  • Familiarity with Microsoft® Office; and
  • Strong communication and presentation skills a plus.
  • Must hold a valid drivers licence


Medpace Overview

Medpace is a full-service clinical contract research organization (CRO) providing phase l-lV clinical development services to the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and medical device industries. Our mission is to accelerate the global development of safe and effective medical therapeutics through the advancement of clinical research. We leverage in-country regulatory and therapeutic expertise across all major therapeutic areas including oncology, cardiology, metabolic, endocrinology, central nervous system, and anti-viral and anti-infective. Headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, we employ more than 6,500 people across 40+ countries.


Why Medpace?

When you join Medpace, you become part of an innovative team that brings cutting-edge therapies to market while building a meaningful and rewarding career focused on scientific excellence and improving patient outcomes around the world through continuous learning and cross-functional collaboration.

Purpose-Driven Work

    • Work alongside physicians, scientists, and industry-leading experts committed to advancing the global development of medical therapeutics through clinical research excellence

Collaborative Culture

    • Contribute to an interactive team environment that empowers decision making, creative thinking, and continuous learning through open communication and mutual trust.
    • Leadership throughout Medpace is both accessible and approachable

Continuous Growth & Development

    • Office based environment with on-site mentors
    • Defined career paths with clear advancement opportunities
    • Industry renowned onboarding and training programs designed to accelerate professional development
    • Ongoing training and continuous learning opportunities throughout your career
    • An environment that encourages employees to influence change, contribute ideas, and grow quickly

Other Employee Benefits

    • Competitive compensation programs that recognize and reward performance
    • Comprehensive health, wellness, retirement, and PTO benefits
    • Office based culture with occasional WFH that provides flexibility for eligible positions after training
    • Company-sponsored social events

Please note benefits may vary based on country.

What to Expect Next

A Medpace team member will review your application and if your profile matches our current needs, you will be contacted for an interview. While we review all applications carefully, we are unable to respond to every applicant, and only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.

raw.excerpt: Overview Working at Atlassian Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two.
raw.description:
Overview

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

Responsibilities

What you'll do

In this role, you’ll join the Customer Success Architect team within Sales and Success as a CSA (AI-Service Management). This is an individual contributor role reporting to a regional leader. You'll help enterprise customers adopt Atlassian's AI-powered Service Collection: Jira Service Management (JSM), Customer Service Management, Assets, and Rovo Service Agents.

You'll lead time-boxed technical engagements and build solutions alongside customers, helping them turn traditional service desks into modern, AI-first service operations. Working with enterprise IT and business service leaders, you'll assess how they work today and co-design workflows across request, incident, problem, change, and asset management. You'll also help customers put autonomous and assisted AI experiences into production.

As a technical expert in Atlassian solutions, you'll deliver effective guidance at scale to help customers increase adoption and get more from their investment. The work involves connecting product capabilities with customers' business needs and desired outcomes. You'll partner with Pre-Sales, Post-Sales, and Product teams to provide solutions and technical guidance that help customers reach their goals.

You'll also help our strongest customer promoters share their successes with peers. As part of that work, you'll lead efforts to expand the Atlassian System of Work into IT, enterprise functions including HR, Facilities, Legal, and Finance, and customer service use cases.

Qualifications

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.

This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.

On your first day, we'll expect you to have:

  • Discovery: Assess customers' service maturity and AI readiness across IT Service Management (ITSM), Enterprise Service Management (ESM), and Customer Service Management (CSM). Review ticket volume data, recurring requests, and knowledge health to find high-impact opportunities for deflection and automation.

  • Design: Work with customers to design AI-first service workflows, including conversational request channels in Slack and Teams, multi-tier queues, change risk models, and Assets/CMDB schemas. Configure and fine-tune Rovo Service Agents for automated triage, deflection, smart routing, and context generation.

  • Deploy: Help customers move from pilot to production. Validate deflection rates, agent accuracy, SLAs, alerting and on-call processes, and automated change policies. Establish continuous learning loops so service teams can monitor, refine, and scale AI agents independently.

  • Collaborate: Work with Account Teams, Customer Success Managers, and Service Collection specialists on technical activation plans. Help customers modernize from legacy tools such as ServiceNow, Zendesk, and BMC, or from standalone Opsgenie.

  • Advocate: Share insights from customer feedback, adoption patterns, and technical friction that relevant Atlassian product and engineering teams can act on. Document validated use cases, reusable patterns, and customer outcomes to improve future engagements and help scale with the JSM, Assets, and Rovo engineering and product teams.

  • Travel up to 15% domestically and internationally for events and customer meetings.

Your background

  • Customer Success & Experience: 3-5 years in Customer Success, technical consulting, or solutions architecture, managing Enterprise customers with complex SaaS portfolios in IT or service operations.

  • Technical Aptitude: Hands-on experience implementing Jira Service Management. Familiarity with other Service Management products, such as ServiceNow, Zendesk, and BMC. Practical experience configuring conversational AI, virtual service agents, automated triage, and workflow automation. Experience with Assets/CMDB modeling, API integrations (monitoring, chat, CRM), and optimizing knowledge sources (Confluence) for AI retrieval.

  • Solution Area Expertise: Deep knowledge of IT service management, service management across business functions, and ITIL 4 practices (incident, problem, change, request, knowledge, and asset/configuration management). Understanding of Knowledge-Centered Service (KCS) principles. ITIL 4 Foundation certification or higher required.

  • Product Mindset & Communication: Strong product mindset with the ability to translate technical AI capabilities into clear business outcomes (deflection, MTTR reduction, CSAT) for IT leaders and executive stakeholders. Comfortable balancing rapid agent prototyping with enterprise-grade governance and reliability.

Benefits & Perks

Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits.

About Atlassian

At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.

We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.

To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit go.atlassian.com/crh.

In line with local law, identity verification (which may include use of biometric data) is a condition of employment with Atlassian for employment fraud purposes.

Job Title: DevOps Engineer

Location: Remote – Latin America
Type of Contract: Full-Time | 1-Year Contract (Possibility of Extension or Permanent Hire)
Salary Range: $2,600–$3,000 USD/month (Market Rates; candidates with exceptional experience may be considered above range)
Ideal Start Date: January 4, 2027

Our client is seeking a highly skilled DevOps Engineer with strong cloud infrastructure, server migration, and systems administration experience to support the migration of their existing on-premises server infrastructure to Google Cloud managed services. You will play a critical role in maintaining infrastructure stability, scalability, security, and performance while supporting an environment serving approximately 1,300–1,500 clients. This role requires a hands-on engineer with deep technical expertise who can manage complex infrastructure and ensure a seamless cloud transition.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, execute, and support the migration of existing on-premises server infrastructure to Google Cloud managed services.
  • Manage, monitor, and optimize cloud infrastructure supporting approximately 1,300–1,500 clients.
  • Ensure infrastructure reliability, availability, scalability, and performance throughout the migration and ongoing operations.
  • Implement and maintain automation for infrastructure provisioning, deployment, monitoring, and operational processes.
  • Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, networking, server, and application performance issues.
  • Implement and maintain security best practices, access controls, backups, disaster recovery, and infrastructure protection.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to minimize downtime, ensure business continuity, and support the successful transition to cloud infrastructure.

Must-Have Qualifications

  • Strong, hands-on DevOps engineering experience managing complex infrastructure and production environments.
  • Proven experience migrating on-premises servers or self-managed infrastructure to cloud environments.
  • Solid experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), particularly managed services and cloud infrastructure.
  • Strong knowledge of Linux server administration, networking, virtualization, and infrastructure troubleshooting.
  • Experience with infrastructure automation, scripting, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure-as-code tools.
  • Ability to manage production systems at scale, with a strong focus on reliability, performance, and uptime.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to independently manage complex technical challenges.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience implementing security frameworks, compliance requirements, or ISO standards (ISO 27001 exposure is a strong plus).
  • Background in infrastructure security, vulnerability management, access management, and security audits.
  • Experience managing large-scale client environments or multi-tenant infrastructure.
  • Previous experience leading or significantly contributing to cloud migration projects.

This role requires strong communication skills, a professional telephone manner, and the ability to manage multiple administrative responsibilities while working closely with the Australian team.The position reports directly to the Australian Practice Manager.

Key Responsibilities

  • Inbound Client Calls: Act as the first point of contact for incoming phone calls to the client, handling client enquiries professionally and directing calls to the appropriate team members when required.

raw.description:
Our client is an established international financial technology company specialising in secure, fast and reliable cross-border money transfers and payment solutions. With over 20 years of industry experience, the company provides digital remittance services to individuals and businesses across European markets. Through its innovative online platform, mobile application and multilingual customer support, the business enables seamless international transactions. Operating within a regulated financial services environment, the company combines advanced payment technology with a strong commitment to security, accessibility and customer service.

Role Overview

The Digital Product Growth Manager owns our client’s funnel numbers end to end: registration, first transfer, repeat transfers and referrals. Their new mobile app went live in October 2026 and their analytics tool shows lots of opportunities for improvements of the sales funnel. Next, They are building a receiver-led remittance app for various African countries: receivers request money, earn rewards and refer their senders abroad. We are hiring two full-time remote people based in Nigeria, Ghana or Kenya: a Digital Product Growth Manager and a Product Designer, working as a pair. Both hires will shape that product from the start. They are self-funded and run a lean, remote team. They want people who are growth geeks and want to have hands fully in, not to manage a department.

Job Type: Full Time/Permanent

Location: Nigeria/Ghana/Kenya

Workplace: Remote

Requirements

  • 3–5 years in growth or product growth at a remittance, payments or consumer fintech company
  • Has personally run A/B tests for minimum 1-2 years on an app onboarding or sign-up funnel, with results they can show
  • Hands-on with Amplitude or a similar tool(not only reading reports)
  • Understands KYC, compliance limits and what builds trust in money apps
  • Good enough English to communicate in the team meetings
  • Good to have
  • Direct remittance experience (LemFi, Moniepoint, Flutterwave, Paga, Chipper Cash, Taptap Send, Sendwave or similar)
  • Knows remittance diaspora - sender and receiver behaviour in Nigeria, Ghana or Kenya
  • The person they want
  • Currently number two or three in a growth team, who wants to own the whole funnel instead of one slice. Curious, data-driven, comfortable working directly with the founder.

Responsibilities

  • Be keen to understand the client journey to the smallest detail and work with Amplitude dashboards; find where and why users drop off
  • Define and prioritise test hypotheses and run A/B tests every 1-2 weeks, with the designer and our developers
  • Improve onboarding and KYC steps without breaking compliance rules
  • Design client nurturing via behavioral science and behavioral economics
  • Design referral and reward mechanics for the receiver-led app
  • Report weekly to the Managing Director on what was tested, what won and what's next
  • Be responsible for maximizing product growth

Business Intelligence Developer - Full Time (Remote)

Our Organization:

CDP, a Boston-based public benefit corporation, uses the collaborative fundraising model to improve the operational efficiency and revenue generation capacity of the public media system.  CDP currently provides more than 230 NPR and PBS public media organizations (PMO’s) with outsourced marketing, data analytics, fundraising, and technology services.  These services help PMO’s raise more net income, grow their donor files faster, lower their fundraising costs, and free up development talent allowing stations to better focus on local engagement.  Since its inception, CDP has delivered more than $1 billion in membership revenue for local PMO’s participating in its services and has become the most widely adopted Public Media service in the history of public media.

Just as CDP is committed to supporting public media organizations around the country, we are equally committed to supporting each of our team in their own professional development.

For more information visit

Department Overview:

BI Developer for the Audience Activation Platform

The Audience Activation Platform is CDP’s newest offering for mission-driven organizations, aiming to build a more perfect view of the entire donor. We gather insights everywhere, from real-world and virtual events to socials, volunteer, donation, and other activities. With this comprehensive, connected, and real-time data, organizations can glean novel insights about what truly drives donor behavior, and tailor activities accordingly.

The BI Developer is responsible for defining, documenting and creating powerful insights-based, AI-driven services and products for the AAP. Dashboards, data visualizations, templates and other tools are the stock-in-trade of this role. This key role is an expert in turning data into insights, and insights into actionable recommendations, especially for users approaching data-driven analysis for the first time.

Role Overview:

Reporting to the Director of Product Management and working closely with partner organizations developing data pipelines and platforms, the BI Developer works collaboratively, iteratively, and quickly to craft truly important offerings for our clients. They exhibit a fine balance between solo action and team collaboration.

Responsibilities:

  • Business Intelligence and Analysis: Design, develop, and test AI-enabled insights and analysis tools. Create clear, powerful visualizations that surface key audience intelligence (e.g., engagement, activation, retention, attribution).
  • Translate Data into Insights: Analyze campaign, CRM, and donor data to identify actionable patterns and trends in audience behavior. Employ AI-native thinking to drive results.
  • Collaborate on Product Features: Work with the product team to support the development of satisfying services that incorporate metrics, benchmarks, and UX guidance around data display.  Act as a liaison with data engineering team to define specifications and use-cases for data model development.
  • Define & Document Metrics: Document and track the business logic for core product KPIs — ensuring consistency and trust in how metrics are calculated.
  • Support Data Quality & Testing: Validate dashboard outputs, investigate data issues, and assist in UAT for new analytics features.
  • Engage with Client Data: Support onboarding by reviewing data mappings, helping interpret source formats, and advising on visualization logic.
  • Assess feasibility: Assess and make recommendations to product and technology leadership on which technology best meets the business requirements.

Skills & Experience:

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in data-driven business intelligence, ideally working with product teams to build products and services for external clients or customers.
  • Minimum 3 years building visualizations with Tableau, PowerBI, QuickSight, Hex, Sigma, Thoughtspot or Looker.
  • Minimum 1 year of hands on, AI-enabled BI development.
  • understanding of and experience with semantic data models and layers
  • Demonstrated experience creating data visualizations and experience creating interactive, multi-layered dashboards
  • Proficiency in SQL and comfort querying large datasets independently
  • Experience working with marketing or CRM data (e.g., campaign engagement, segmentation, donation trends)
  • Understanding ofcustomer journeys, funnel metrics, or donor lifecycle analysis.
  • Experience using and building APIs to access complex data sets a plus

Behaviors and Attributes

Action Bias – Moves quickly from discovery and identification through  qualification and closing, testing early and often, with a high degree of comforting executing through ambiguity

Communicative & Social – Able to adapt communication mode and style for teams, individuals and situations seamlessly and naturally

Assertive – be a voice of clarity and authority, driving action and decisions

Creatively Collaborative – continually finds ways to learn, teach, and work side-by-side with their team

Strong communicator -who can translate between user needs, product capabilities, and business outcomes.

Trusted Advisor – Engender trust and build psychological safety with every interaction

Enthusiastic – High-energy, motivated, and driven

raw.description:
📋 Tâches et responsabilités

Dans le cadre de programmes de transformation et de l'évolution de l'expérience clients, le consultant senior accompagnera le responsable Expérience Clients au sein de la Direction Marketing.

La mission comporte deux volets complémentaires :

  • Assurer le rôle de point de contact et de coordination pour l'organisation dans le cadre de travaux d'interopérabilité billettique coordonnés par un organisme sectoriel.
  • Apporter un appui stratégique et opérationnel au responsable Expérience Clients, en prenant en charge de manière autonome des analyses, des dossiers de transformation et des chantiers transversaux.

Le consultant évoluera dans un environnement réunissant de nombreux interlocuteurs métiers, techniques et institutionnels, ainsi que plusieurs projets stratégiques menés en parallèle.

📌 Missions et responsabilités

1. Coordination des travaux d'interopérabilité billettique

Vous serez le point de contact privilégié de l'organisation pour la coordination opérationnelle de ces enjeux.

À ce titre, vous serez notamment chargé de :

  • Assurer l'interface entre l'organisme de coordination sectoriel, les partenaires techniques et les différentes parties prenantes internes.
  • Coordonner les contributions des équipes métiers, techniques et support, en veillant à la cohérence des positions de l'organisation.
  • Analyser les documents de cadrage, les propositions et les livrables, en identifier les impacts pour l'organisation, puis préparer les positions et arbitrages nécessaires.
  • Assurer le suivi des engagements, des jalons, des décisions, des risques et des points ouverts.
  • Veiller à la cohérence entre les travaux d'interopérabilité et les initiatives internes, en particulier le programme de transformation billettique.
  • Préparer les instances de suivi et de gouvernance, les synthèses décisionnelles ainsi que les reportings destinés au management.
  • Anticiper les difficultés, proposer des solutions et faciliter la prise de décision.

Vous assurerez une coordination transverse, sans vous substituer aux responsables de projets ni aux experts métiers et techniques.

2. Appui stratégique et opérationnel au responsable Expérience Clients

En parallèle, vous soutiendrez l'avancement de dossiers stratégiques et transversaux.

Vos responsabilités comprendront notamment :

  • Prendre en charge de manière autonome des études et analyses stratégiques, du cadrage du besoin jusqu'à la formulation de recommandations.
  • Contribuer à la définition et au suivi des objectifs stratégiques de la Direction Marketing.
  • Concevoir et structurer des outils de pilotage de la performance, notamment un cockpit de management, des KPI, des tableaux de bord et des plans d'action.
  • Réaliser des analyses d'opportunité, de faisabilité et d'impact sur des initiatives liées à l'expérience clients, aux services et aux canaux digitaux.
  • Structurer des dossiers d'aide à la décision comprenant des diagnostics, des scénarios, des recommandations, des feuilles de route et des supports pour les instances de direction.
  • Faciliter la coordination de projets ou de chantiers transversaux, suivre les actions et contribuer à la résolution des points de blocage.
  • Préparer et suivre certains dossiers prioritaires pour le compte du responsable du département.

Vous devrez être capable de transformer des problématiques complexes ou peu structurées en propositions concrètes, argumentées et directement exploitables.

📌 Résultats attendus

Vous devrez rapidement devenir opérationnel sur les deux volets de la mission, avec pour objectifs :

  • Mettre en place une coordination structurée et proactive de la participation de l'organisation auprès de l'organisme de coordination sectoriel.
  • Fournir une visibilité claire sur les engagements, les échéances, les risques et les décisions attendues.
  • Produire de manière autonome des livrables stratégiques de qualité, nécessitant un minimum de reprises par le management.

📝 Votre profil

Vous avez une expérience confirmée en conseil en stratégie et en transformation.

  • Vous maîtrisez le conseil en stratégie (Strategic Management Consulting) et pouvez mener de manière autonome des analyses, des recommandations et des dossiers de transformation.
  • Vous avez une expérience en gestion de projets digitaux (Digital Project) et en suivi de projets ou de chantiers transversaux.
  • Vous êtes à l'aise dans la gestion des parties prenantes (Stakeholder Management) au sein d'un environnement réunissant des interlocuteurs métiers, techniques et institutionnels.
  • Vous vous exprimez en néerlandais, en anglais et en français.

💼 Offre

Vous ferez partie d'une PME belge en pleine croissance, où l’initiative et le développement personnel sont encouragés. Nous vous offrirons un environnement de travail agréable, entouré(e) de collègues sympathiques. Ensemble, nous élaborerons un plan de carrière, avec une attention particulière et un budget dédié à la formation ou à la certification complémentaire. Vous pouvez compter sur un salaire attractif, complété par des avantages extra-légaux, y compris une voiture de société.

(Freelance est également possible)

raw.description:
Role Title: Distinguished Researcher, Research Program

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

Time commitment: Time commitment is flexible. We understand that researchers at this level balance teaching, labs, and other research, so you set a weekly schedule that works around your existing commitments.

micro1 is engaging Distinguished Researchers, Research Programs to contribute to an innovative customer project at the frontiers of computational science. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. This opportunity is designed for early-career researchers with standout recognition, ready to drive progress on significant open problems and influence the future of AI research.

Scope of Work

  1. Identify and propose an impactful open problem or theoretical bound within your research subfield for targeted investigation.
  2. Develop and execute sustained research strategies using advanced AI agents on tasks such as proofs, algorithmic innovation, and computational simulations.
  3. Meticulously verify all findings through reproducible computations, formal tools, or line-by-line proof validation prior to external review.
  4. Collaborate with program engineers and AI model specialists to enhance agent performance and address technical challenges encountered during exploration.
  5. Document research attempts, partial progress, and validated results with clarity and structure to facilitate independent peer review.
  6. Deliver structured feedback on AI agent behaviors, strengths, and weaknesses to inform the evolution of frontier AI models.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Standout early-career achievements, including at least one best paper award at a premier venue (e.g., STOC, FOCS, SODA, PLDI, SC) or a recognized dissertation/early-career award; proof of recognition is required.
  2. Advanced standing as a late-stage PhD, postdoc, or within five years post-PhD in computer science, mathematics, or computational physics.
  3. Recent publication record with multiple papers in top-tier venues within the past three years and at least one breakthrough contribution or open problem advancement.
  4. Hands-on expertise in computational research methods, including simulation, numerical analysis, or algorithm development and implementation.
  5. Demonstrated excellence in written and verbal communication, evidenced by clear documentation and peer-reviewed outputs.
  6. Experience reviewing or sub-reviewing for major conferences and/or publicly applying formal verification tools or frontier AI models in research contexts (desirable).
  7. An online research statement or homepage detailing ongoing or targeted open problems (preferred).

How the process works

  1. Apply and complete the AI interview. This is a short, structured interview covering your research background and approach.
  2. Recruitment and hiring manager review. Our team and the hiring manager review your application, recognition, and recent publications.
  3. Interview with the recruitment team. Part of this conversation focuses on the open problem you’d propose to tackle in the program. Afterward, you’ll submit a short written proposal on that problem.
  4. Final interview (optional). Some candidates will have a final conversation with the hiring manager or one of our internal researchers.
  5. Onboarding. Selected researchers are onboarded and given access to the agents, compute, and engineering support.

raw.description:
About Darkhorse Tech

Darkhorse Tech is a managed IT services provider built for dental. We support 1,500+ dental practices, specialists, multi-location groups, and DSOs nationwide with day-to-day IT support, cybersecurity, HIPAA compliance, cloud hosting, and email security. We are 100+ people who work almost entirely in one industry, which means we get good at it.

About This Role

We are hiring a Service Manager to own service delivery across our Service Team and our NOC.

Read that carefully, because it is the part most candidates miss. This is not a seat where you manage a help desk. You will manage five team leaders, four Technical Team Leaders and one NOC Team Lead, who together carry fifty-two people between them. Your job is not to solve tickets. It is to build five leaders who run their teams well, hold the same standards, and make good calls without asking you first.

If you are a strong technician who wants to keep touching the work, this is the wrong job. If you have managed managers before and you get satisfaction out of watching someone you coached handle something they could not have handled six months ago, keep reading.

What You'll Do

  • Manage and develop four Technical Team Leaders and one NOC Team Lead through consistent one-on-ones, clear expectations, and real accountability
  • Own the service KPIs across both organizations: response time, resolution time, CSAT, ticket aging, and backlog
  • Make the experience consistent, so a client gets the same Darkhorse regardless of which pod takes the ticket, and a technician gets the same standards regardless of which lead they report to
  • Oversee NOC operations including backup verification, email security, third-party vendor coordination, practice management software updates, and proactive monitoring, and keep NOC integrated with Service rather than running as a separate island
  • Serve as the escalation point when a Team Leader cannot resolve a client issue, and then fix the reason it escalated
  • Own service delivery for our largest DSO accounts, multi-location groups running dozens of practices, including escalation, SLA performance, and driving consistency at scale
  • Review escalation patterns and resolution quality, and address root causes instead of individual tickets
  • Establish and enforce service processes, workflows, and documentation standards
  • Partner with People and Culture on hiring, onboarding, performance, and retention across the service organization
  • Carry quarterly ROCKs on our Service Traction Leadership Team

What We're Looking For

  • Real experience managing managers. Not managing a team of technicians. Managing the people who manage the technicians. This is the single most important qualification.
  • IT service leadership experience, ideally at an MSP
  • Track record of moving service KPIs, and the ability to talk specifically about what you changed and what happened
  • Comfort with NOC functions: backup verification, email security, monitoring
  • Experience with multi-location or enterprise accounts. Our largest DSO clients expect a different level of consistency than a single practice does.
  • Coaching instinct. You develop people rather than working around them.
  • Analytical and process-driven. You look at the data before you look for someone to blame.
  • Solid grounding in HIPAA, cybersecurity fundamentals, and ITIL principles
  • PSA and RMM experience. ConnectWise preferred.

Nice to Have

• Dental or healthcare IT background

  • Familiarity with dental practice management software (Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Open Dental)
  • Experience integrating a NOC function with a reactive service desk

• EOS or Traction experience

Details

Location: Remote, anywhere in the U.S.

Schedule: Full-time, standard business hours Eastern, with coordination of Saturday and after-hours coverage across teams

Reports to: VP of Operations

Direct reports: Five (four Technical Team Leaders, one NOC Team Lead)

Compensation: $95,000 to $115,000, depending on experience

Why Darkhorse

Our technicians are not generalists guessing at a dental practice's software. We know this industry, and our people build real relationships with the practices they support instead of taking anonymous tickets off a national queue.

This role has been in place and is being backfilled, so you are not inventing it from scratch. You are inheriting five leaders and a working structure, with room to make it better.

Darkhorse Tech is an equal opportunity employer.

Salary: $95,000 – $115,000 / year

Overview

TISTA Science and Technology Corporation is seeking experienced VistA / MUMPS Developers to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Supply Chain Management Development Security Operations (SCM DSO) program.

The VistA / MUMPS Developer will support the development, sustainment, and modernization of the Integrated Funds Distribution, Control Point Activity, Accounting and Procurement (IFCAP) system, a critical component of the VA's Veterans Health Information Systems and Technology Architecture (VistA).

This position is responsible for maintaining and enhancing MUMPS-based applications, developing and supporting system interfaces, resolving production issues, implementing security updates, and ensuring the continued reliability of VA purchasing, inventory, and financial management systems.

IFCAP supports purchasing, funds control, inventory management, and procurement operations across VA medical centers. The system operates on InterSystems IRIS within the VA Enterprise Cloud on AWS and integrates with modern VA platforms, including the Integrated Financial and Acquisition Management System (iFAMS) and VA Logistics Integration Platform (VALIP).

At TISTA, you’ll do meaningful, mission-driven work that improves lives alongside teammates you trust and leaders who are transparent and supportive. We invest in your learning and internal mobility so you can build a career that keeps advancing. We’re proud to serve and hire Veterans, and we put people first in everything we do.

TISTA associates enjoy above Industry Healthcare Benefits, Remote Working Options, Paid Time Off, Training/Certification opportunities, Healthcare Savings Account & Flexible Savings Account, Paid Life Insurance, Short-term & Long-term Disability, 401K Match, Tuition Reimbursement, Employee Assistance Program, Paid Holidays, Military Leave, and much more!


Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, troubleshoot, and enhance MUMPS-based applications supporting VA VistA and IFCAP systems.
  • Maintain and modify IFCAP routines, including inventory management, purchasing, and financial processing functionality.
  • Develop, test, and deploy application enhancements and defect fixes through established VistA patch release processes.
  • Support the development and maintenance of interfaces connecting IFCAP with VA enterprise systems.
  • Collaborate with interface developers and technical teams to document and explain IFCAP business logic and data structures.
  • Develop and maintain MUMPS components supporting item master, procurement, and financial system integrations.
  • Support integrations with iFAMS, VALIP, and other connected VA applications.
  • Perform regression testing to ensure system stability following platform upgrades and integration changes.
  • Identify and remediate security vulnerabilities, including findings from automated security scans.
  • Investigate and resolve production incidents escalated through VA Tier 2 support and patch coordination teams.
  • Troubleshoot application defects, data inconsistencies, and system performance issues.
  • Maintain compliance with VA VistA coding standards, configuration management practices, and patch release requirements.
  • Collaborate with developers, architects, testers, and cybersecurity teams to support application sustainment and modernization.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation covering application changes, system interfaces, and troubleshooting procedures.
  • Participate in Agile development activities, code reviews, testing, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Support knowledge transfer and documentation to ensure continuity of critical system expertise.

Qualifications

  • Minimum five years of professional software development experience using MUMPS/M on VistA or a comparable enterprise system.
  • Strong experience developing, maintaining, and troubleshooting MUMPS-based applications.
  • Working knowledge of VA FileMan, VistA Kernel, and Remote Procedure Calls (RPCs).
  • Experience developing, testing, and releasing VistA patches.
  • Experience working with InterSystems IRIS or Caché database technologies.
  • Experience maintaining legacy enterprise applications and supporting production systems.
  • Experience troubleshooting application defects, data processing issues, and production incidents.
  • Understanding of VistA application architecture, data structures, and software development practices.
  • Experience performing application testing, debugging, and regression validation.
  • Ability to analyze existing code, identify root causes, and implement reliable solutions.
  • Strong analytical, technical documentation, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with developers, architects, testers, technical leadership, and government stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Direct experience supporting IFCAP or the VA Generic Inventory Package (GIP).
  • Knowledge of VA procurement, purchasing, inventory management, and financial operations.
  • Experience developing or maintaining interfaces between VistA and modern enterprise applications.
  • Experience exposing VistA data through REST APIs, web services, or HL7 messaging.
  • Familiarity with VA financial systems, including iFAMS.
  • Experience supporting InterSystems IRIS or HealthShare environments.
  • InterSystems IRIS or HealthShare certification.
  • Experience working within Agile development teams using Jira and Git.
  • Familiarity with federal cybersecurity requirements, application security scanning, and vulnerability remediation.
  • Experience supporting application modernization, legacy system integration, and cloud-hosted environments.
  • Experience supporting Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) or other federal healthcare IT programs.
  • Active or recent VA background investigation and identity credential.

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Clearance:

  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a Tier 2 / Moderate Risk Public Trust background investigation and VA identity credential.

Location:

  • Remote within the United States, subject to VA approval. Occasional travel within the continental United States may be required.

Pay Range:

  • The suggested pay for this position ranges from $95,000 to $150,000 annually.
  • The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.
  • Also, certain positions are eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as bonuses.

In deze rol analyseer je processen, documenteer je datastromen en ondersteun je initiatieven rond dataclassificatie, governance en informatiebeheer. Je vertaalt noden uit de business naar duidelijke vereisten voor data management en governance.

Verantwoordelijkheden

  • Je documenteert hoe data wordt verzameld, verwerkt, opgeslagen, gedeeld, bewaard, gearchiveerd en verwijderd.
  • Je helpt bij het vastleggen van data ownership, stewardship en verantwoordelijkheden.
  • Je toetst bestaande werkwijzen aan interne policies en externe verplichtingen.
  • Je signaleert risico's rond gevoelige, vertrouwelijke of gereguleerde informatie en formuleert verbetervoorstellen.
  • Je ondersteunt rapportering en communicatie rond governancebevindingen.

📝 Your profile

  • Je hebt minstens 1 jaar ervaring als Business Analyst, Data Lifecycle Management Analyst of in een gelijkaardige functie.
  • Je hebt ervaring in een internationale en gereguleerde omgeving.
  • Je bent sterk in het analyseren en documenteren van bedrijfsprocessen.
  • Je begrijpt hoe data doorheen de volledige lifecycle wordt aangemaakt, verwerkt, opgeslagen, gedeeld en verwijderd.
  • Je kan businessnoden vertalen naar concrete governance- en datavereisten.
  • Je communiceert vlot met zowel business als technische teams en kan stakeholders op verschillende niveaus meenemen.
  • Je hebt ervaring met stakeholdermanagement, workshopfacilitatie en procesverbetering.
  • Je kan werken met process mapping, workflows, business requirements en operating procedures.

  • Ervaring met BPMN, data mapping, data lineage en reporting tools is relevant voor deze opdracht.
  • Ervaring met Microsoft Purview, SharePoint, Power BI of gelijkaardige governance tools is een plus.
  • Kennis van GDPR, data protection, information security, audit of compliance is mooi meegenomen.
